### CodeMaru-Dreamine/Dreamine.Gem — STRONG / MASTER REFERRAL — 27/30
- URL: https://github.com/CodeMaru-Dreamine/Dreamine.Gem
- Exact revision: `82604d6f03c1e95e0558de5c757989b27cd4a3d6` (2026-08-17).
- Date inspected: 2026-09-20.
- Category: Repository / Reusable Component / SECS-GEM Pre-FAT Harness.
- Concrete capability: Stateful host + equipment E30/GEM implementation over real HSMS/TCP with communication/control state, variables/constants, clock, dynamic event reports, alarms, remote commands, bounded spooling, Stream-9 behavior and typed outcomes. It explicitly freezes an `E30-0611 derived subset profile v1` rather than claiming generic/current conformance.
- Buyer/problem: Semiconductor equipment OEMs, fabs, MES/EAP teams and integrators lose expensive engineering time when host/equipment upgrades fail late FAT because dialogue state, ACKs, report/event mapping, command completion or HSMS semantics differ.
- First paid wedge / monetization: Fixed-price **SECS/GEM pre-FAT profile regression** on an authorized profile, returning a reproducible state/dialogue/error gap report before FAT or rollout; do not market as official SEMI certification.
- Build-time/domain advantage: Saves months of E30/E5 state, service, failure-semantic and actual-TCP harness work.
- Evidence inspected: `KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md`, `docs/SEMI_REQUIREMENTS_TRACE.md`, `E30RouterLoopbackTests.cs`, `GemHsmsLoopbackTests.cs`, tree/history. Actual-TCP tests cover communication establishment, online/offline state, read/write behavior, report/link/event ordering, alarms, remote-command acceptance vs completion, invalid mutation rejection before state change and correlated Stream-9 errors. External simulator/production equipment is explicitly `NOT_RUN`; E37.1 conformance is `BLOCKED_STANDARD`.
- Public license/rights: MIT for repository code; user-asserted separate commercial authorization is the working posture for repository-owned code. SEMI standards/revisions, vendor catalogs and customer profiles remain separately governed.
- Score: A4 + B5 + C5 + D5 + E4 + F4 = **27/30**.
- Combination: Pair with `LostCat-Qian/secs-simulator` as independent scenario/SML driver and existing unrelated SECS engines for differential pre-FAT testing. `Dreamine.Secs.Com` is same-family and does not count as an independent oracle.
- Knowledge-to-value: capability delta = stateful SECS/GEM pre-FAT acceptance; graph edge = strengthens `CAP-014` and can extend `EXP-008` into semiconductor host/equipment acceptance; radar = test-rich conformance-adjacent virtual FAT; experiment impact = add a synthetic dialogue/error matrix; commercial impact = high-cost semiconductor integration wedge; negative knowledge = local traceability/TCP success is not current SEMI conformance.
- Verifier verdict: **STRONG for the frozen implemented subset**, not field-proven/current-certification.
- Next action: Run the same frozen dialogue/error corpus against one unrelated SECS/GEM engine/simulator and classify every disagreement.

## 2026-09-20 — PON intent-to-wire migration bridge sweep

### balapi/netconf-polt — STRONG — 25/30
- URL: https://github.com/balapi/netconf-polt
- Exact revision: `47bf310a9dd3f92e8fcdae2eefe3980ee149fc1d`.
- Date inspected: 2026-09-20.
- Category: Repository / Provisioning Engine / NETCONF-pOLT-to-OMCI Bridge.
- Concrete capability: pOLT control stack bridging BBF-style NETCONF/YANG service intent into ONU-management/OMCI state. Deep source inspection found MIB Upload/MIB Upload Next structures, MIB-data-sync/transaction counters, managed-entity reconstruction, OMCI flow state, TCONT/GEM tracking and explicit delete-state progression for GEM interworking/mapper/network-CTP objects plus VLAN-flow semantics.
- Buyer/problem: OLT vendors, access integrators and ISP broadband engineering teams need to prove that higher-level service intent actually becomes expected ONU MIB/TCONT/GEM/VLAN state before controller, OLT-software or ONU-profile migration.
- First paid wedge / monetization: Fixed-price **intent-to-wire PON migration proof**: load rights-clean synthetic/authorized service intent, drive pOLT/OMCI, capture the session and independently reconstruct/diff resulting ONU state.
- Build-time/domain advantage: High; saves months of NETCONF/YANG→OMCI orchestration, MIB-sync and GEM/TCONT/VLAN service-state work.
- Evidence inspected: `onu_mgmt/libomcistack/omci_stack_api.h/.c`, OMCI transport state, MIB Upload Next receive/decode, service ONU/flow state, TCONT/GEM tracking, tree and Apache-2.0 license. Strong automated-test evidence did not surface in this inspection.
- Public license/rights: Apache-2.0 for repository-owned code; user separate commercial authorization applies to repository code. BBF YANG/models, vendor SDKs/APIs, standards and customer ONU/service profiles remain separately governed.
- Score: A4 + B5 + C5 + D4 + E3 + F4 = **25/30**.
- Combination: `netconf-polt` service-intent driver → `RainbowCloudLabs/omcipcap` independent capture/MIB reconstruction → BBSim/OBBAA/OpenCORD synthetic endpoint/control components. This closes **intent → wire → reconstructed state → diff**.
- Knowledge-to-value: capability delta = higher-level PON service-intent driver above the OMCI evidence plane; graph edge = closest existing pattern is `CAP-014`/`EXP-008` pre-FAT acceptance adapted to access networks, with no dedicated central telecom CAP yet; radar = software-defined access acceptance moving from protocol mocks toward intent-to-observed-state evidence; experiment impact = planted GEM/TCONT/VLAN/profile drift benchmark; commercial impact = sell proof that proposed service intent becomes the same ONU state before rollout; negative knowledge = limited public tests and unresolved lineage/vendor dependencies mean this cannot be sole oracle.
- Verifier verdict: **STRONG as a bridge, not yet an independent oracle**. Relationship/provenance versus OBBAA/OpenCORD/Broadcom families is unresolved and test depth caps evidence.
- Next action: Provenance/lineage diff first; then run one synthetic intent→OMCI capture→OMCIPcap state-diff experiment with planted GEM/TCONT/VLAN mismatches.
